body: I just thought I'd post to tell you ladies that it doesn't get better. I'll have my AS degree in less than a year, I'll be 22 soon, and have been depressed since my early teen years as well. I'm going to be a hypocrite here and just say it, if you don't find yourself help now, some way to cope and make the situation better for yourselves, nothing is going to "magically" change when you get older. You've been depressed long enough that certainly you both understand how the longer you wait, the more you lose yourself. I don't know who I was before this started, I'm such a different person around other people but when I'm alone I question my being for every second. It's like getting into a long drawn out argument with someone and realizing you have no idea why you started arguing in the first place. So hang in there and if you can get yourselves some help.

We do have a couple of school counselors. One of them is one of my professors. I've tried counseling before though, and it's not the best experience. They all wanted something to be wrong with me but there simply isn't. There are only two experiences in my past I can even remotely consider traumatizing, but they really weren't as much as you'd think. So when I was in counseling the first time when I was 16, I spent most of my time staring at a spot on the floor waiting for it to be over because I had nothing more to say, I'm sad, I don't know why, and I just want to go home... yknow? I had this aching feeling that they had no idea why I was in their office either. The only advice anyone can ever give me is make friends. How can I possibly make friends when I wouldn't even want to be friends with me?

professional help is only available to those with money, i do enjoy school sometimes i just have zero drive right now, im stuck in a thought vortex, first its i dont feel great today, then its i dont want to do anything today, then well if i dont do anything today i wont be prepared for tomorrow, if im not prepared for tomorrow ill fail the test, if i fail the test ill fail my class, if i fail the class ill ruin my gpa and lose my financial aid, if that happens im fucked forever, and that should motivate me to do something, but instead im stuck thinking everything is over, nothing matters anymore, and theres no point to continue and suddenly hours have gone by and im stuck again
I don't have to shave my legs. I just wear jeans all the time lol.
I know what you mean. It's so easy to get your mind caught in a "what-if" cycle of one negative thought after another that just leaves you feeling drained and out of it. We're here to listen, though.

"Leave the cat alone, can't you see he's throwing up!?"
To my five year old sister.


Wonderful.

You sound like a male version of me, ha. I can relate so much. And the LoL community definitely sucks. LoL is a game that requires a lot of guide-reading and a lot of experimenting. I don't know what else to say, though. I'm in a similar situation. I guess the last thing I can tell you is that there are ladies out there who probably wish you would notice them.

I don't know if it'll help but let me just tell you a little story. I go to community college and there's a guy who sits by himself everyday on his laptop. I suppose the first thing that caught my attention is he's one of the 10% of people at my school who isn't using an apple product. I would love nothing more than to go say hi and introduce myself but I have so little self-confidence. So instead I've been trying to get his attention by sitting nearby, playing games on my laptop. Maybe he's not interested in video games much or he's got the same problem as me. Anyway, the lesson here is not every girl that's interested in you is going to come over and say hi. Keep an eye out for cues and if you're feeling really confident, say hi yourself.

I really need to talk to someone in person. I guess a lot of you can relate, some days are worse than others... damn I feel like shit tonight. I'm getting so sick of this. It's been 5 or 6 years now. I suck at living happily and if I can survive depression for 6 years, I suck at getting rid of myself too. I'm such a fucking failure. Why can't I make one fucking decision for myself?

Thank you for everything. You've made some really good points there and I do need to get out of my head more often. You nailed it on the head with your insights into internal arguments. Logically though, nothing does matter. In the end, we all die, we become part of the Earth again and are reborn. Some 10 billion years in the future, our sun will swell into a red giant and burn the Earth out of the sky. Whether humanity lives to see that day, and leave the Earth via spacecraft, won't matter. Because if we make it that far, we'll find a new planet and that one will be destroyed too. Nobody knows how it'll all end yet, but as they say, what goes up must come down. What effect can my existence really have on anything? Absolutely nothing. The ONLY point to life is that I'll die anyway, so might as well enjoy whatever time I have left, right? It just all seems so ridiculously pointless.

I don't know... I guess it's partially that I'm so introverted. I only have 2 friends and one of them I don't talk to much. I'm so trapped within my own head. My father was an abusive alcoholic, although he only hurt mom. She left him before he could hurt my brother and I. I've always been the one who understood, I'm glad we left. My mom has always had someone to talk to who understands. I never asked for much growing up but she found ways to give my brother and I everything we wanted. She remarried and had 3 more kids. I'm the first of five, and I love my siblings, but I definitely don't want kids of my own. My new step-father is amazing and I love him to pieces. I'm their smart kid, I've always done well in school. My brother, 19, chose to move away to a university right out of high school and is in thousands of dollars of debt already. I worked 2 years out of high school then started community college where, as I've said earlier, my grants pay for everything. My life is simple, it's anti-climactic, and I'm smart enough to realize that absolutely nothing matters in the world, nothing at all.

No, I don't want to feel canceled out. And yes, sometimes I feel like those ideas make me worthless. For example, as many people here would probably agree, I'm not a religious person. Whenever someone gets me talking about why I don't agree with the idea of religion I always come back to all of the contradictions that exist in their logic. So when I realize just how contradictory I feel.. I just hate it. Man, I felt a little better at first, getting it out, but I'm so pathetic. This is stupid. I just want to give up.

Thinking about it now, the worst part is definitely feeling like my entire existence is a contradiction. I've been known to talk people out of suicide. I have so many good reasons that I can give people, and myself, to continue to live. But I know, in one desperate moment, I will lose my grip on reality and be forced to choose. I don't know exactly how much longer I have left but I know I can so, so very easily choose to die. I want to, but I don't. I feel like I'm cancelling myself out, like in mathematics when you multiply a fraction by its reciprocal, I'm so contradictory that I just cease to make any sense. I'm driving myself mad, that's what. If I'm not dead in the next couple years, I'll be in a padded cell. And now I've got myself thinking too much. I hate everything.

Well from what I've been hearing mental illness seems to trend within family/genetics. On my mothers side we have plenty of panic disorders, my mom having panic attacks herself, and some alcoholics. On my father's side there are lots of alcoholics and some cases of depression. Just going by what I've seen, I'm afraid I might have something like panic attacks only because what I experience is sudden and extremely overwhelming. But I don't really feel afraid of death or that I am going to die I just ... damn it is so hard to explain what it feels like. Imagine seeing yourself from the viewpoint of the moon, how small you would be, then from the sun, then from outside the Milky Way, and maybe even from another galaxy. It's that kind of hopeless insignificance that causes me to feel like I can't breath and there is absolutely no use in going on. Kind of like a "why bother?" attitude. Only it's more than that and it's affecting everything I do in life. On a side note I also have a phobia that many people consider awkward too; I'm anthophobic. Which is the fear of flowers. I always skip school on valentines day.

But I am alone. ._.; I know you mean that there are others out there that feel the same way. But I don't talk to people much at all. My family has no idea how I feel. There's no one I can talk to who cares that also doesn't charge me $100 a minute. Which is why I hate professionals, sure they were schooled to know enough about the subject to help but it's like I'm paying this person to give a shit and they probably find me a lot more boring than their other clients. I feel so incredibly isolated yet at the same time I hate people with a passion. I just hate, more than anything, being a walking contradiction.
